CustomField.description: The Digital Edge legal entity contracting with this customer for this deal. Lookup to an Account record with RecordType = DE Entity. Replaces the Account-level DE_Subsidiary__c picklist so one Account can deal with multiple DE entities across Opportunities.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select the Digital Edge legal entity responsible for this deal (e.g. DE JP KK for Japan, DE SG Pte Ltd for Singapore). Set per Opportunity - one customer can have different contracting entities across deals.
CustomField.label: DE Subsidiary
